verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Cards are order intents that give the agent a fixed allowance with an amount and an expiration, enforced through Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay. The merchant is locked for the intent's lifetime, credentials are minted as one-time card numbers, and the agent never sees the real card number; intents stop working when cancelled, expired, or fully spent, and they are revocable. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of these controls, and broader card eligibility (Visa use is limited to eligible US-issued cards with several exclusions, and the encrypted-card fallback returns the real saved card to the private-key holder when no network rail is usable).
